subject.title: feat(qwen): add Token Plan (Team Edition) provider

question: Should OpenClaw accept `qwen-token-plan` as a bundled official qwen provider contract after the generated catalog/reference repair lands?
rationale: The implementation is plausible and well-proven, but adding a new provider id, auth choices, env var, model catalog, and outbound hosts is a maintainer-owned product/support commitment.

options.title: Accept after generated repair

options.title: Keep it external
